name: Dr. Kousik Kumar Dutta
subtitle: Computer Science Researcher | Open to Collaboration
bio: I am a computer science researcher working on preference-aware routing, time-dependent road networks, and scalable graph algorithms. I completed my PhD defence in Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Ropar in September 2026, after doctoral work on constrained maximization of preferences on time-dependent road networks. My research combines algorithms and systems, with an evolving agenda in database systems, spatial and network data management, scalable computing, and graph query processing. I am interested in building research programmes that connect rigorous algorithm design with useful systems, and in teaching the foundations that help students reason about data, software, and computation. I am open to collaboration on graph algorithms, data systems, transportation networks, and related teaching or research initiatives.
dissertation: Constrained Maximization of Preferences on Time-Dependent Road Networks

researchDirections.title: Constrained and Preference-Aware Path Query Processing
researchDirections.short: Efficient approaches for constrained and preference-aware path queries in large transportation networks, including route choices that evolve under time-dependent conditions.
researchDirections.description: Investigating efficient approaches for processing constrained and preference-aware path queries in large transportation networks, with particular interest in how route choices evolve under time-dependent conditions.

researchDirections.title: Scalable Graph Representations and Path-Closure Processing
researchDirections.short: Graph representations and query-processing techniques for connectivity and path relationships in large networks, with an emphasis on scalable data management.
researchDirections.description: Exploring graph representations and query-processing techniques that support efficient analysis of connectivity and path relationships in large networks, with an emphasis on scalable data management and reusable computation.

researchDirections.title: GPU-Accelerated Graph Analytics and Query Processing
researchDirections.short: Parallel and hardware-accelerated approaches for large-scale graph workloads, with attention to irregular computation, data movement, and path-query execution.
researchDirections.description: Exploring parallel and hardware-accelerated approaches for large-scale graph workloads, particularly the challenges of irregular computation, data movement, and scalable path-query execution.
